issue.title: Fix enemy getting stuck at walls during patrol movement (#1357)
issue.body:
## Summary

Fixes enemy pathfinding where enemies cannot follow their planned patrol path and get stuck/stand still (Issue #1357).

**Root cause (confirmed via owner-provided game log 2026-03-23):**

The patrol point snap runs on an **empty navmesh** (0 polygons). Level scripts bake the navmesh asynchronously (`await get_tree().physics_frame` + `bake_from_source_geometry_data`), but enemies spawn in the same `_ready()` call before the bake completes. The previous 1-frame delay was not enough. With 0 polygons, `NavigationServer2D.map_get_closest_point()` returns a garbage position 1800–2000px away, so all patrol points are flagged as unreachable and removed. The enemy then has no valid patrol path.

Game log evidence:
```
[Enemy7] Patrol point 0 at (1700, 870) unreachable (dist to navmesh: 1909.7), removed
[Enemy7] Patrol point 1 at (1800, 870) unreachable (dist to navmesh: 1999.2), removed
[Enemy7] Patrol point 2 at (1600, 870) unreachable (dist to navmesh: 1821.2), removed
[Enemy7] Patrol points snapped to navmesh (3 points)   ← all removed, snapped 0 points
```

## Changes

- **Fix 4: Navmesh polygon count guard** — Before snapping patrol points, check `NavigationServer2D.map_get_polygon_count(nav_map) == 0`. If the navmesh has no polygons yet (bake not complete), return early and retry next frame. This ensures the snap only runs on a valid, baked navmesh. (`scripts/objects/enemy.gd`, `_process_patrol()`)

- **Previous fixes still present (Fixes 1–3):**
  - Raycast wall check to prevent snapping across walls
  - Nav direction priority when wall avoidance overrides pathfinder >90°
  - Skip consecutive unreachable patrol points in stuck detection

- **Case study updated** — `docs/case-studies/issue-1357/` includes the owner's game log and updated root cause analysis

## Files changed

- `scripts/objects/enemy.gd` — Fix 4 (navmesh polygon count guard) in `_process_patrol()`
- `docs/case-studies/issue-1357/README.md` — Updated with confirmed root cause
- `docs/case-studies/issue-1357/game_log_20260323_140633.txt` — Owner-provided game log

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify patrol enemies (e.g. Enemy7, Enemy10 in BuildingLevel) now move along their patrol paths instead of standing still
- [ ] Verify patrol points are snapped correctly after navmesh bakes (log should show reasonable distances <10px, not 1800+px)
- [ ] Verify no regression on levels with pre-baked navmesh (instant bake, 0-frame delay)
- [ ] Verify wall-hugging / stuck behavior is fixed in the labyrinth level
- [ ] Verify enemy path debug overlay (Enemy path visible: true) shows patrol paths correctly once enemies are moving

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#1357

issue.title: fix(#1357): minimal nav direction guard to prevent wall-sticking
issue.body:
## Summary

Fixes enemy pathfinding where enemies get stuck at walls during path-following movement (PURSUING, FLANKING, PATROL). Single minimal fix in `scripts/objects/enemy.gd`, function `_move_to_target_nav()`.

## Root Cause

The `_apply_wall_avoidance()` function uses 8 raycasts and applies weights of 0.3–0.7 to steer away from walls. When the valid navigation path runs close to a wall (corridors, corners, doorways), wall avoidance can apply up to **70% weight AGAINST the nav direction**, effectively overriding the pathfinder and causing the enemy to oscillate or get stuck.

## Fix

**Nav direction guard** in `_move_to_target_nav()`: Save the NavigationAgent2D direction before wall avoidance. After wall avoidance, if the resulting direction has turned >90° from the original (dot product < 0), blend back toward the nav direction (70% nav / 30% avoidance):

```gdscript
var nav_direction := direction; direction = _apply_wall_avoidance(direction); if nav_direction.dot(direction) < 0.0: direction = (nav_direction * 0.7 + direction * 0.3).normalized()
```

The fix is condensed to a single line to stay within the 5000-line CI limit for `enemy.gd`.

**What this does NOT change:**
- Wall avoidance still works normally when it doesn't fight the nav path (dot >= 0)
- Patrol point snapping logic is untouched
- No changes to any other functions

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify enemies follow navigation paths through corridors without getting stuck at walls
- [ ] Verify PURSUING/FLANKING states navigate through doorways and narrow passages
- [ ] Verify no regression on open-area combat (wall avoidance still works when needed)
- [ ] Verify patrol enemies move along patrol paths normally

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#1357

issue.title: fix(#1357): prevent enemies getting stuck at wall corners during path following (v2)
issue.body:
## Summary

Fixes enemies unable to follow their navigation path through wall corners (Issue #1357). Two complementary fixes applied:

### Fix 1: Remove enemy-enemy physical collision (v1)

All enemy `CharacterBody2D` scenes had `collision_mask = 6` (binary `110`), making enemies physically collide with both walls (layer 3) and other enemies (layer 2). When multiple enemies navigated a tight corner simultaneously:

1. Physical enemy-enemy collision pushed enemies laterally into the wall
2. Corner escape logic (Issue #1107) read mixed enemy+wall collision normals → incorrect escape vectors
3. Wall avoidance raycasts fought the nav-computed direction at corners
4. Result: deadlock at corners

**Owner confirmed:** "до их добавления враги хорошо проходили поворот" (before adding enemy collisions, enemies navigated corners correctly).

**Fix:** Changed `collision_mask = 6` → `collision_mask = 4` in all 4 enemy scene files, removing enemy-enemy physical collision while keeping the three existing soft avoidance mechanisms (ORCA, separation steering, tactical yielding).

### Fix 2: Fast corner escape when pursuing cover (v2)

After owner testing confirmed the single-enemy corner stuck still occurred: the `_global_stuck_timer` fires at 4s default (up to 20s with experimental settings). This is too slow — enemies appear visibly stuck.

**Fix:** In `_process_pursuing_state`, within the `_has_pursuit_cover` block, added 6 lines of fast corner escape:
- When `_global_stuck_timer > 2.0` AND enemy is still >30px from cover target
- Collect slide collision normals (wall contact points)
- If wall normals exist: apply 2× escape velocity along the averaged normal direction (directly counters the physics wedge)
- If no wall contact: abandon current cover target and find a new one
- Resets stuck timer after each escape attempt

This fires before the 4s/20s global stuck timer, providing fast recovery from corner wedges during PURSUING state.

## Root Cause

Owner's observation: "возможно проблема в коллизиях врагов (до их добавления враги хорошо проходили поворот)" — enemy-enemy collisions fight navigation at corners.

Additionally, the Godot `CharacterBody2D` physics can mechanically pin at concave wall corners (two surfaces meeting at 90°) where `move_and_slide()` decomposes velocity into near-zero tangential components. Our fast escape fires after 2s of no-progress and directly applies escape velocity from collision normals.

## Evidence

Game logs analyzed in `docs/case-studies/issue-1357/`:
- `game_log_20260325_064110.txt` — owner test on BuildingLevel, 10 enemies PURSUING (log too short to capture stuck event but owner confirmed visual observation)
- See also `docs/case-studies/issue-1457/` (related corner stuck analysis by PR #1477)

## Files Changed

- `scenes/objects/Enemy.tscn` — `collision_mask = 6` → `4`
- `scenes/objects/EnemySwatShield.tscn` — `collision_mask = 6` → `4`
- `scenes/objects/EnemyDroneOperator.tscn` — `collision_mask = 6` → `4`
- `scenes/objects/RadioJammerEnemy.tscn` — `collision_mask = 6` → `4`
- `scripts/objects/enemy.gd` — +6 lines fast corner escape in `_process_pursuing_state`
- `docs/case-studies/issue-1357/README.md` — case study updated with v2 analysis
- `docs/case-studies/issue-1357/game_log_20260325_064110.txt` — owner's test log

**Line count: 4998/5000** (within CI limit)

## Test Plan

- [x] All CI checks passing (8/8)
- [ ] Verify enemies follow navigation paths through corners without getting stuck
- [ ] Verify PURSUING/COMBAT states navigate through corridors and doorways
- [ ] Verify enemies still avoid each other (ORCA + separation steering work without physical collision)
- [ ] Verify tactical yielding still works in narrow passages
- [ ] Verify fast corner escape fires and recovers within 2s of being stuck

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#1357
